_comment: Hand-written golden for POST /ui-bridge/control/assert (plan 2026-11-12-structured-assert-arms-never-pass-and-diagnose-assertions-never-reach-the-route, D2). Read by Rust (src-tauri/src/mcp/ui_bridge/structured_assert.rs: every case builds exactly its script) and by vitest (src/hooks/ui-bridge-events/structuredAssertScripts.dom.test.ts: every script yields passed=true on passHtml and passed=false on failHtml through the page's real evaluate gate and compiler). hand-written: never regenerate from the builder.

cases.name: isVisible-css
cases.script: (() => { var els = document.querySelectorAll("p"); var visible = Array.from(els).filter(function(el) { var r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none'; }); return JSON.stringify({ found: els.length, visible: visible.length, passed: visible.length > 0 }) })()

cases.name: hasText-css
cases.script: (() => { var els = document.querySelectorAll("p"); var texts = Array.from(els).map(el => el.textContent.trim()); var found = texts.some(t => t.includes("hello")); return JSON.stringify({ found: els.length, texts: texts.slice(0, 3), passed: found }) })()

cases.name: hasClass-css
cases.script: (() => { var els = document.querySelectorAll("p"); var found = Array.from(els).some(el => el.classList.contains("active")); var classes = Array.from(els).slice(0, 3).map(el => Array.from(el.classList).join(' ')); return JSON.stringify({ found: els.length, classes: classes, passed: found }) })()

cases.name: hasAttribute-present-css
cases.script: (() => { var els = document.querySelectorAll("p"); var found = Array.from(els).some(el => el.hasAttribute("title")); return JSON.stringify({ found: els.length, passed: found }) })()

cases.name: hasAttribute-equals-css
cases.script: (() => { var els = document.querySelectorAll("p"); var found = Array.from(els).some(el => el.getAttribute("title") === "Tip"); return JSON.stringify({ found: els.length, passed: found }) })()

cases.name: exists-text
cases.script: (() => { return JSON.stringify({ found: (Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(el => el.childNodes.length <= 3 && el.textContent.trim() === "hello")).length, passed: (Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(el => el.childNodes.length <= 3 && el.textContent.trim() === "hello")).length > 0 }) })()

cases.name: exists-textContains
cases.script: (() => { return JSON.stringify({ found: (Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(el => el.childNodes.length <= 3 && el.textContent.includes("ell"))).length, passed: (Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(el => el.childNodes.length <= 3 && el.textContent.includes("ell"))).length > 0 }) })()

cases.name: hasText-gate-word
cases.script: (() => { var els = document.querySelectorAll("p"); var texts = Array.from(els).map(el => el.textContent.trim()); var found = texts.some(t => t.includes("Connect WebSocket")); return JSON.stringify({ found: els.length, texts: texts.slice(0, 3), passed: found }) })()
